arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, c.card_type
arguments.explanation: For each card type (Credit, Debit, Debit (Prepaid)), this returns the number of labelled transactions, how many of them are fraud, and the fraud rate, highest rate first.
assumptions: Fraud rate counts only labelled transactions. Transactions with no label are left out, not counted as legitimate.
Card types are kept as they appear in the data, so 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)' are reported separately.
